definitions.gloss: letter of resignation (formal request to resign)
definitions.explanation: A formal document submitted to request resignation. Phrased as a request (not a declaration), it can be withdrawn before the employer accepts it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{退職願|たいしょくねがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}した→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I submitted my letter of resignation to my supervisor.

examples.japanese: {退職願|たいしょくねがい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧⟦{封筒|ふうとう}→封筒：02952_fuutou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧だ。
examples.english: It is common to deliver a letter of resignation in a white envelope.

examples.japanese: {退職願|たいしょくねがい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{受理|じゅり}→受理：12032_juri⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧なら⟦{撤回|てっかい}→撤回：12910_tekkai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A resignation request can be withdrawn before it is accepted.

notes:
Literally 'resignation request'. The {願|ねがい} (request) framing makes it a petition, not a unilateral statement — so it can be withdrawn if the employer has not yet accepted it. This distinguishes it from ⟦{退職届|たいしょくとどけ}→退職届：15695_taishokutodoke⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{退職届|たいしょくとどけ}→退職届：15695_taishokutodoke⟧: notice of resignation — a unilateral declaration that takes effect after submission; cannot be withdrawn
- ⟦{辞表|じひょう}→辞表：27086_jihyou⟧: resignation letter — used for executives and public officials; more formal/serious

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {退職願|たいしょくねがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to submit a letter of resignation
- {退職願|たいしょくねがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧: to submit a letter of resignation (formal)
- {退職願|たいしょくねがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write a letter of resignation
- {退職願|たいしょくねがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撤回|てっかい}→撤回：12910_tekkai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to withdraw a resignation request
